# k0rdent_webhook_subscription (List Resource)

Finds every `k0rdent_webhook_subscription` a `terraform query` can adopt, by its identity. With `include_resource = true`, or under `-generate-config-out`, each result also carries the object as an import of that identity would read it, so the generated configuration is what an import plans against. Terraform 1.14 and later.

Every webhook subscription the provider's credential can see. Each is shown by its id, never its URL, since a receiver's URL can carry a token: `url` is in the object `include_resource` returns, and in state once adopted, as it always was. An adopted subscription has no signing secret in state, since the platform answers it only when it's set: the import guide says what a configuration that sets one plans.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every webhook subscription the provider's credential can see.
list "k0rdent_webhook_subscription" "all" {
  provider = k0rdent
}
```
